propositions: The current _optionality.yml workflow fans out into 6 separate matrix jobs (5 per-extra + union), each consuming a concurrent job slot while holding setup overhead, causing 21 total concurrent slots needed and exceeding GitHub Free's 20-slot org limit.

The per-extra matrix extras {agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding} do not match _optional.EXTRAS keys {agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}, leaving metrics without per-extra CI coverage and including mcp which has no detection probe.
Collapsing per-extra and union jobs into a single venv-loop job that iterates over _optional.EXTRAS plus mcp (7 total iterations) reduces peak concurrent slots and adds metrics CI coverage.

The loop must use absolute venv paths ("$v/bin/python", "$v/bin/rebar-mcp"), never source activate, accumulate errors across iterations with rc=1 on failure, and include checked-in test guards preventing silent failures from stacked activations or ambient interpreter contamination.

The union iteration installing .[agents,eval,tracing] jointly into one venv is not redundant with isolation runs; it surfaces joint dependency resolution failures that per-extra installs alone cannot catch.

infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json hard-codes doomed check names that must be updated to reflect the collapsed workflow, since emergency rollbacks via rollback-mirror-lock.sh POST this file back as a ruleset.
